title.narrative: Proposal preparation for Climate-Smart Agriculture, Agroforestry, Seaweeds, and Fisheries in BARMM

description.narrative: A comprehensive project proposal developed for KOICA, focusing on climate-smart and inclusive development of agriculture, agroforestry, fisheries, and seaweed cultivation value chains in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). The project will deliver a detailed scoping study, including policy and planning needs analysis, investment opportunity identification, capacity-building needs assessment, and a concept note for KOICA, all focused on climate-smart and inclusive development of agriculture, agroforestry, fisheries, and seaweed cultivation value chains in the BARMM region.

title.narrative: By supporting the development of a comprehensive project proposal focused on climate-smart and inclusive agriculture, agroforestry, fisheries, and seaweed cultivation value chains, this project will lay the foundation for sustainable economic growth, enhanced food security, and poverty reduction in BARMM.
